text: dsh-voice 为 DSH Web 添加语音输入界面，包含实时听写和语音消息录制。听写可按停顿切句并将识别文本追加到输入框；语音消息支持点击或按住说话、取消倒计时和发送前预览。识别支持云端及本地提供方回退链，也可配置离线浏览器识别、语音整理模式、快捷键和语音宏。适合希望免手动输入提示词的 DSH Web 用户；云识别需自行配置相应服务凭据，本地引擎则需配置服务和模型。

dsh-voice adds real-time dictation and voice messages to the DSH Web UI. It segments speech, inserts transcripts, and supports editable previews, provider fallback chains, offline recognition, processing modes, hotkeys, and spoken macros. Cloud providers require credentials.
想在 DSH 网页里直接说话输入提示词。
有没有能把语音实时转成输入框文字的方式？
我想按住快捷键录一段话，松开后发给 agent。
让 DSH 根据说话停顿自动切分听写内容。
需要把本地录音文件转成文字供 agent 使用。
想给技术术语设置词汇提示，提高语音识别准确度。
能不能用本地语音识别，避免选择云端识别服务？
我想把口述内容整理成任务或笔记格式再输入。
I want to dictate prompts into the DSH web composer.
Can speech be split at pauses and inserted as I talk?
I need an agent to transcribe an audio recording from disk.
I want voice recognition to fall back across multiple providers.
「实时听写」：麦克风录音按静音停顿切成短句，识别结果逐段追加到 DSH 输入框。
「语音消息」：点击或按住录音，识别后显示可编辑预览，并在配置的取消倒计时结束后发送。
「多提供方识别」：按配置顺序尝试云端或本地语音识别，单个服务失败时可继续使用后续提供方。
「转录音频文件」：agent 可调用 transcribe_audio，提交文件路径和可选语言并获得识别文本。
「离线浏览器识别」：可在页面以 WebGPU 或 WebAssembly Whisper 模型处理语音。
「识别文本处理」：听写支持逐字、清理、任务、笔记等模式，并允许为各模式配置自定义提示词模板。
「语音宏」：可为口述触发短语配置提示词模板，将识别出的内容展开为带有文本参数的结构化提示。
「本地 SenseVoice 安装」：界面可查看 SenseVoice 安装状态并触发模型安装。

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · ⚡ Overview：**`dsh-voice`** brings voice superpowers to the **DeepSeek Harness** Web UI. Whether you need hands-free real-time streaming dictation segmented on natural breath pauses or crisp voice notes with keyboard/mouse Push-to-Talk gestures, `dsh-voice` ensures your audio is never lost thanks to **automatic multi-provider fallback chains**.

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · ✨ Key Features：* 🎙️ **Streaming Dictation with VAD**: Speech is automatically sliced at natural pauses (`vadSilenceMs`, default 700ms) and typed into the composer in real time.
* 🌊 **Voice Notes with Cancel Window**: Record your thought and have it automatically dispatched to the agent after a safety countdown (`autoSendMs`, default 4000ms).
* 🎮 **Tactile Push-to-Talk**:
  * **Mouse**: Hold the wave button — releasing sends the message; dragging pointer away discards.
  * **Keyboard**: Hold <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> (or custom hotkey) for hands-free speaking; press <kbd>Esc</kbd> to cancel.
* ⚡ **Live In-Browser Captions (`browser`)**: Web Speech API speech-to-text with real-time floating captions as you speak (Note: standard browser recognition typically streams audio to vendor servers like Google in Chrome; for true 100% offline privacy, use local `whisper` or `sensevoice`).
* 🛡️ **Ironclad Multi-Provider Fallbacks**: If your primary cloud provider runs out of credits or hits a 429 rate limit, requests seamlessly fail over down the chain.

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · 🎮 Four Ways to Speak：| Mode | Gesture / Trigger | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| **Dictation** | Click <kbd>🎙️ Mic</kbd> | Speech is sliced on pauses (`vadSilenceMs`) and typed live into composer |
| **Voice Message** | Click <kbd>🌊 Wave</kbd> | Records until stopped, then sends after cancel window (`autoSendMs`) |
| **Mouse PTT** | Hold <kbd>🌊 Wave</kbd> | Records while held; release sends message, drag off button to discard |
| **Keyboard PTT** | Hold <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> | Hands-free recording; release sends message, press <kbd>Esc</kbd> to discard |

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · ⚙️ Configuration：> **Composer button visibility (#326, #328)**:
> The `showDictationModeButton`, `showDictationButton`, and `showMessageButton` settings allow independently toggling the visibility of voice action buttons in the composer area (`conversation.input.right`).
> - When a button is disabled, it is cleanly removed from the interface across both current and newly opened chat tabs.
> - When all three buttons are disabled, the container returns `null` and unmounts with zero DOM footprint.
> - Settings persist reliably across application restarts in both Desktop and Web profiles (saved in `cordis.patch.yml`).
> - Underlying voice functionality (including keyboard push-to-talk with `hotkey: Control`, Silero VAD, and STT pipelines) remains fully active.
> - Primary navigation buttons (`Remote`, `Tasks`, `Kanban`, `Scheduled Tasks`) belong to separate core slots and remain completely unaffected.

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · ⚙️ Configuration：> **Note on language handling**: Setting `language: ""` (default) allows providers to auto-detect the spoken language. Spoken numeral normalization (`wordsToDigits`) and standard Russian tech slang correction (`DEFAULT_JARGON_DICTIONARY`) activate conditionally only when Russian is selected or auto-detected in the transcript, ensuring non-Russian speech is never distorted.

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · Agent Tool (`transcribe_audio`)：Registers `transcribe_audio(file_path, language?)` in `ctx.tools`, allowing agents to analyze audio files, interview recordings, and voice notes directly from disk. Path containment is strictly enforced against allowed directories (`allowedAudioDirs`, `~/.dsh`, `tmpdir`, `cwd`) with symlink traversal escape prevention and magic-byte audio format validation.

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · Internal HTTP & WebSocket Endpoints：* `GET /dsh-voice/ws/stream` — RFC 6455 WebSocket streaming channel for real-time dictation with interim transcription previews (`{ type: 'interim', text }`) and final transcript dispatch (`{ type: 'final', text, action, provider }`). Authenticated via `hasSameOrigin` or `x-dsh-voice-token` (#282, #292).
* `POST /dsh-voice/transcribe` — `{ dataBase64, mimeType, mode }` → `{ ok, text, provider, tookMs }`
* `POST /dsh-voice/polish` — `{ text }` → `{ ok, text }`
* `GET /dsh-voice/status` — Returns daemon status, active chains, SenseVoice and `effectiveSensevoiceProvider`. Emits `sessionToken` exclusively to verified same-origin callers (#292).
* `GET /dsh-voice/config` — Returns live plugin configuration snapshot.
* `PUT /dsh-voice/config` — Updates and persists plugin configuration across network with automatic session token rotation (#292).
* `GET/POST /dsh-voice/sensevoice-installer` — SenseVoice 1-click model installation status and trigger (protected by `isTrustedCaller`, model paths redacted).
* `POST /api/dsh-voice/update` — Triggers plugin self-update to latest compatible npm version (protected by local calle

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · Internal HTTP & WebSocket Endpoints：> **Security & Quota Protections (#292, #293)**: State-changing HTTP routes and WebSocket upgrades enforce strict same-origin verification and token authentication against reverse LAN bridges (such as `dsh-lanmode`), preventing unauthorized configuration changes or quota depletion. Real-time interim WebSocket streaming processes only the latest audio chunk ($O(N)$ linear byte consumption) and restricts recognition strictly to local engines (`local-whisper`, `sensevoice`, `browser-webgpu`), ensuring zero cloud quota consumption during interim speech preview.

@goodandready/dsh-voice README · 🔒 Profile Lock & Controlled Operator Recovery Policy：When updating or installing plugins, DeepSeek Harness profiles coordinate concurrent operations using `<profile-dir>/package.json.lock` (for example, `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json.lock`).
* **Canonical Contender Policy**: The contender process never deletes or unlinks an existing lockfile. Automatic stale lock removal by contenders is prohibited to eliminate TOCTOU (Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use) race conditions and prevent unintended lockfile clobbering.
* **Diagnostics**: If `<profile-dir>/package.json.lock` is present, update attempts return `409 Conflict` with clear diagnostics:
  - If held by an active process, the PID is reported.
  - If filesystem inspection encounters access errors (`EACCES`, `EIO`), the operation fails closed with the error code preserved. Filesystem errors require inspecting filesystem health, permissions, or mount options — **do not** remove the lockfile in response to `EACCES`/`EIO`.
